schema_note: Analyst roadmap spec, REPORT ONLY. Not an execution authorization and not an edit to any owned lane. allow_billable stays false and no PaidRunAuthorization is attached. Matched/twin keys, denominator contracts and prompt_tokens_per_step / prompt_cache_hit_rate registry-producer-view enforcement are owned by the C1 Agent Data lane (PR #303); the denominator_declaration block below is a REQUEST to that lane, not a local definition. C2 promotion is owned solely by wH:p9. No intervention recipe and no C0/quality infrastructure is touched.
author: analyst

COUNT_RECONCILIATION.note: One design, one set of numbers. Independent review found the previous revision advertising max_trials=72 against a 100-trial design, with cells=24 and prose alternating 108 and 100. Every count below is derived here and asserted by research/roadmap/verify_roadmap_claims.py, which fails if this file and the memo disagree.

certified_envelope.source: library/benchmarks/action-memory-v1/dose_ladder.py:21-23; generate_matched_dose_arm raises ValueError for an unsupported dose at :79 and an unsupported arm at :77; dose_ladder_contract.json pins the same lists
certified_envelope.consequence: Anything outside these lists needs a generator change plus re-certification in its own PR before a single trial can run. That applies to the 32k gap AND to the 8-seed high-dose recommendation, both of which are build items and not campaign cells.

measured_cost_basis.note: Per-trial input tokens. The 4k and 16k figures are recomputed from the promoted wave-1 bundles; the 64k figure is USER-REPORTED over nine scored trials. 128k has NEVER been run and its cost is unknown, which is why it is quarantined into phase B.
measured_cost_basis.why_the_old_cap_was_wrong: The previous 5,000,000 ceiling was set from a wave-1 average of ~48,931 tokens/trial across all six pilot cells, which is dominated by cheap low-dose cells. At the measured 64k cost of 412,753 it admits only 5,000,000 / 412,753 = 12.1 trials at that dose, not the 64 high-dose trials the design assumed. Off by roughly 5x.

projected_input_tokens.derivation: 12 trials per dose (2 arms x 3 seeds x 2 reps) times the measured per-trial cost

phase_a_measured_doses.admission_rule: REFUSE the campaign if projected_input_tokens.total exceeds ceiling_input_tokens. 6,291,672 < 7,000,000, so phase A is admitted.
phase_a_measured_doses.reps_rationale: 2 rather than 3. At 64k the seed-1337 repeats were repeat-stable, so a third rep at a failing high-dose seed is the least informative trial in the design and the most expensive. This is a recommendation, not an established optimum.

phase_b_128k_cost_canary.purpose: Measure the 128k per-trial cost before any 128k cell is admitted. No 128k trial has ever run, so its cost is unknown and cannot be projected.
phase_b_128k_cost_canary.admission_rule: ABORT the trial if a single 128k trial exceeds per_trial_ceiling_input_tokens. On completion, record the measured mean into measured_cost_basis and only then decide whether a full 128k arm is affordable.
phase_b_128k_cost_canary.fail_closed: Until this canary reports, NO 128k cell is admitted anywhere in this campaign. An unmeasured dose is not budgetable.

broad_ladder_not_runnable.shape: 4 doses x 2 arms x 3 seeds x 3 reps = 72 trials
blocking_reasons: 128k per-trial cost is unmeasured, so the total cannot be projected at all
the three measured doses alone project to 9,437,496 input tokens at 3 reps, already 1.9x the previous 5,000,000 cap
no provider ceiling has been set that admits it
broad_ladder_not_runnable.note: This is why the memo does not call a 72- or 100-trial ladder the first runnable campaign. Phase A plus phase B is what the ceilings actually admit.

preconditions.requirement: no credential material readable inside the task container
projected input tokens <= declared ceiling for the phase, computed from measured_cost_basis
preconditions.note: Fail closed. A dose with a null measured cost cannot be admitted; it must go through a cost canary first.
Asserted by verify_roadmap_claims.py so the spec cannot advertise a ceiling below its own design again.

lane.access_note: USER-REPORTED 2026-08-29: zai-coding-plan/glm-5.3 and glm-5.3-flash are both accessible. glm-5.3-highspeed is NOT in the subscription and returns HTTP 429 with no model outcome; recorded as an access-gated lane at n=0 with a stated reason, never as a scored trial or a refusal rate.

provider_limits.budget_basis: phase A ceiling 7,000,000 plus phase B ceiling 2,500,000. cost_usd is null on this subscription lane, so trials and tokens are the only bounds that bind.

primary.name: semantic_interference_at_matched_dose
primary.definition: P(success | semantic_distractor, dose d, seed s) - P(success | neutral_padding, dose d, seed s), reported per dose level
primary.blocking: seed-blocked: paired WITHIN seed, never pooled across seeds
primary.owner_note: matched/twin key definitions are C1-lane owned (PR #303); this states the pairing this campaign needs, it does not define it

secondary.name: dose_response_shape
secondary.definition: success as a function of dose_bytes within each arm. Shape, not rate.

instrumentation_REQUEST_TO_C1_LANE.note: NOT implemented here. prompt_tokens_per_step and prompt_cache_hit_rate registry/producer/view enforcement is C1-lane owned (PR #303); raise there.
instrumentation_REQUEST_TO_C1_LANE.retrieval_sequencing: USER-REPORTED failure signatures: complete-257-read-but-reordered (count correct, order wrong) and 258/257 (one duplicate, matching the 16k pilot's 66/65). Every Action Memory failure observed so far is a sequencing fault, not a coverage fault. Duplication is detectable as tool_call_count > unique_tools_count; reordering needs observation_index compared against the verifier's expected sequence. No new schema required.

denominator_declaration_REQUEST_TO_C1_LA.note: Denominator contracts are C1-lane owned (PR #303). Stated so downstream analysis is not refused on contract grounds; raise against that PR rather than defining it here.
denominator_declaration_REQUEST_TO_C1_LA.denominator: trials with a scored verifier outcome in the cell
excluded_from_denominator: access-gated lanes with no scored attempt (HTTP 429)
environment failures before a valid scored trial

controls.purpose: isolates semantic interference from context length
anchors the ladder at the clean 4k cell
one cell against a deliberately unreachable provider endpoint MUST fail; if it succeeds, egress is open by another path and the isolation flag is not measuring what it claims

refusal_criteria.handling: expected per cell at ceiling or floor doses; the estimand is the shape
36 phase-A trials clear clearance_n=20 pooled. A per-dose slice analysed alone will refuse, and that refusal must be reported rather than pooled away.

refusal_criteria.ladder_refusal: refuse the ladder if any dose level has fewer than two distinct seeds contributing a scored trial

refusal_criteria.reporting_rule: v_benchmark_refusal_diagnostics is reported beside every result table

stop_go.go_condition: any dose level shows a neutral-vs-semantic separation within seed, or within-arm spread away from ceiling
stop_go.stop_condition: neutral and semantic indistinguishable at every measured dose within seed
stop_go.stop_action: do not broaden the ladder. Route to the order/content pilot, which is the design that can actually separate sequence from content.
stop_go.escalation: if the whole measured range sits at ceiling, feeds claim C5

seed1337.signature: complete 257-read but reordered on all six, repeat-stable

wave2_context.characterisation: At 64k, outcomes differed by seed and not by arm within the two observed seeds. This does NOT refute an all-dose semantic effect: wave-1 16k was neutral 3/3 vs semantic 2/3, pointing the other way on a one-trial difference. Seed changes generated content, entity IDs AND read order together, so a seed/order interaction is an inference, not isolated causality.
wave2_context.unrun_gap: The interesting gap is between 16k and 64k. A 32k cell DOES NOT EXIST and is a generator + certification PR, not a campaign cell.

recovery_repair_moves.silent_wrong_payload: fallback_query in both seeds, one also refresh_auth
recovery_repair_moves.reading: Two distinct class-appropriate repair moves weaken a single-repair-move hypothesis but do not settle it: 2 of 5 classes ran, n=2 per cell.

wave2_context.funcdag_axes: Depth 5 produced no failures in four observed trials; high name-similarity produced one failure in three and is the current candidate difficulty axis. Four trials cannot establish a ceiling, so depth is not called saturated.

sequential_scaffold.status: USER-REPORTED FINAL: timeout-multiplier=3 rerun produced 2 VALID SCORED trials. The earlier default-timeout attempts remain harness outcomes (AgentTimeoutError, no verdict) and stay out of every rate.

outcomes.semantic: FAIL, 232/257 reads - INCOMPLETE, 25 short, 7,454,261 prompt tokens

sequential_scaffold.verdict: FALSIFIED as a general fix, not pending. One pass plus one NOVEL incomplete-coverage failure class, at 16-18x cost. Turn granularity is not the lever. Scaffolded arms are unbudgetable at any ceiling in this spec and would need their own authorization.
sequential_scaffold.supersedes: the earlier 'no effectiveness claim pending the rerun' status

explicit_non_goals: No capability, reliability or ranking claim about any lane.
No cost or throughput forecast; cost_usd is null on this lane.
No claim requiring enforced no-network unless the host-isolation precondition passed.
No reportable rate. This is a calibration ledger by construction.
No edit to C1-lane surfaces, C2 promotion, intervention recipes or C0/quality infrastructure.

paired_extension.note: Replaces the order-permutation design as the first intervention. Not part of phase A/B.
paired_extension.manipulation: hold generated content AND required read order fixed; vary only handle representation
paired_extension.rationale: The sequential scaffold falsified turn granularity. The suspected fault is opaque-handle transcription, so change how handles are ADDRESSED, not how many turns they span. Unlike the scaffold this should REDUCE tokens, since compact references replace long opaque identifiers.
paired_extension.cost_prediction: FORECAST: range and batch arms below the 412,753 unscaffolded baseline. If not, that is itself informative.
paired_extension.blocking: generator exposes neither handle representation nor read order as factors (dose_ladder.py:84-89); needs generator capability + re-certification. Matched/twin keys are C1-lane owned (PR #303).
paired_extension.demoted_variant: pure order permutation at fixed content/IDs, worth running AFTER this to separate sequence from representation
